intro.en: Metallised, holographic and UV-patterned paper and paperboard for cartons, rigid boxes, cards and printed goods.
intro.zh: 用于彩盒、精品盒、卡牌和印刷品的金属、镭射与 UV 光刻纸材和卡纸。

desc.en: Ready-designed UV patterns, chosen from the pattern library.
desc.zh: 已设计好的 UV 纹样，可在纹样图库中选款。

desc.en: Bright and matte silver PET laminated board.
desc.zh: PET 亮银、亚银等金银卡纸。

desc.en: Plain holographic, light-pillar and holographic transfer board.
desc.zh: 素面镭射、光柱、亚光光柱、镭射转移银卡等。

desc.en: Bright silver and coloured aluminium foil laminated paper.
desc.zh: 亮银及彩色铝箔复合纸。

desc.en: Laminated white board, cast-coated high-gloss board.
desc.zh: 覆膜白卡、铸涂高光卡等。

intro.en: PET, holographic and UV-patterned films for laminating, labels and converting.
intro.zh: 用于复合、标签与后加工的 PET 膜、镭射膜和 UV 光刻膜。

desc.en: 12 μm standard gloss and 16 μm high gloss.
Holographic film sold on its own.
desc.zh: 可单独销售的镭射加工膜。
已加工光刻膜，现成或定制款。

intro.en: Boxes, cards, postcards and paper merchandise made with our materials, quoted to your design.
intro.zh: 使用我们材料制作的包装盒、卡牌、明信片与纸制文创，按您的设计报价。

desc.en: Folding cartons and gift boxes in metallised or UV-patterned board.
desc.zh: 采用金银卡或 UV 光刻卡纸的彩盒与礼盒。

desc.en: Collectible cards, game cards and mini cards.
desc.zh: 收藏卡、游戏卡及文创小卡。
常规及特种材料明信片。
按需求承接其他纸制品。
